intro.text: A Pathian who often turns up at community events to speak for his faith.
A Pathian missionary from Elendel, killed by the kandra Bleeder so she could wear his bones and pin a Survivorist priest's murder on him.

items.text: Larskpur made a habit of attending community functions on behalf of Pathism, even though the crowds were mostly Survivorists.

Before about a thousand people at an Elendel chapel, someone in Larskpur's shape took the dais, denounced the Survivor, dropped a curtain to reveal the murdered priest Father Bin, and slipped away. Wax confirmed it had been Bleeder, who shed the disguise in a coach and left Larskpur's bones on the seat; the real Larskpur had evidently been killed some time before.

appearance.text: A small man who barely fills his robes, dressed in a plain Pathian smock.
